release_notes:
- Inbox: choose the library as well as the project when you import what you sent from your phone. Nexus remembers your last choice.
- When a paper is already in the project, Nexus now tells you where it is (project › library) instead of just "already in the project". Tick "Also add it to this library" to put it in the library you chose anyway.
- Papers you already imported can be imported again into another library or project from the Imported view; a PDF that came with them is attached there too.
